Note: if "Engine Whitelist" contains values, action will only count results from those engines. If the submission is done privately, action will mark the entity as suspicious based on the verdict of API without counting the engines.

Specify the percentage of engines should mark the entity as malicious or suspicious, for Siemplify to label it as suspicious. Note: if "Engine Whitelist" contains values, action will only count the percentage from those engines. If both "Engine Threshold" and "Engine Percentage Threshold" are provided, "Engine Threshold" will be used. Maximum value: 100. Minimum: 0.

Specify a comma-separated list of engines that should be used to retrieve information, whether an entity is malicious or not. Example: AlienVault,Kaspersky. Note: if nothing is specified in this parameter, action will take results from every available engine. If the engine didn't return any information about the entity it’s not going to be counted for the parameters "Engine Threshold" and "Engine Percentage Threshold".

AIDescription:
### General Description
Submits one or more files to VirusTotal for analysis and retrieves comprehensive threat intelligence reports. This action supports both local file paths (on the Google SecOps runner) and remote files located on Linux servers via SFTP. It operates asynchronously, polling VirusTotal until the analysis is complete. Once finished, it retrieves AV engine verdicts, community comments, MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques, and AI-generated summaries (for private submissions). The action evaluates the file's risk based on user-defined engine thresholds or percentage thresholds and enriches the case with detailed insights and data tables.

### Flow Description
1. Extracts file paths and optional Linux server credentials from the action parameters.
2. If remote server details are provided, connects via SFTP to fetch the file content; otherwise, it attempts to read the file from the local path.
3. Requests an upload URL from VirusTotal and performs a POST request to upload the file for analysis.
4. Enters an asynchronous state, periodically checking the status of the analysis ID provided by VirusTotal.
5. Once analysis is complete, fetches the full report, including engine results, and optionally retrieves comments, MITRE details, and AI summaries.
6. Calculates whether the file is 'risky' based on the configured thresholds and engine whitelist.
7. Generates a Case Insight for each file, adds data tables for engine results and comments, and provides a direct link to the VirusTotal report.

### Additional Notes
- Either `Engine Threshold` or `Engine Percentage Threshold` must be configured for the action to execute successfully.
- To fetch files from a remote server, all three Linux server parameters (Address, Username, Password) must be provided.
- This action runs in the background and will poll VirusTotal until results are ready.
AiShortDescription: Submits files to VirusTotal for analysis, optionally retrieving them from a remote Linux server, and returns comprehensive threat intelligence reports including AV verdicts, MITRE details, and AI summaries.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| File Paths | String | Yes | Specify a comma-separated list of absolute file paths. Note: if "Linux Server Address" is specified, action will try to fetch file from remote server. |
| Engine Threshold | String | No | Specify how many engines should mark the file as malicious or suspicious, for Siemplify to label it as risky. Note: if "Engine Whitelist" contains values, action will only count results from those engines. If the submission is done privately, action will mark the entity as suspicious based on the verdict of API without counting the engines. |
| Engine Percentage Threshold | String | No | Specify the percentage of engines should mark the entity as malicious or suspicious, for Siemplify to label it as suspicious. Note: if "Engine Whitelist" contains values, action will only count the percentage from those engines. If both "Engine Threshold" and "Engine Percentage Threshold" are provided, "Engine Threshold" will be used. Maximum value: 100. Minimum: 0. |
| Engine Whitelist | String | No | Specify a comma-separated list of engines that should be used to retrieve information, whether an entity is malicious or not. Example: AlienVault,Kaspersky. Note: if nothing is specified in this parameter, action will take results from every available engine. If the engine didn't return any information about the entity it’s not going to be counted for the parameters "Engine Threshold" and "Engine Percentage Threshold". |
| Retrieve Comments | Boolean | No | If enabled, action will retrieve comments about the entity. |
| Max Comments To Return | String | No | Specify how many comments to return. |
| Linux Server Address | String | No | Specify the IP address of the remote linux server, where the file is located. |
| Linux Username | String | No | Specify the username of the remote linux server, where the file is located. |
| Linux Password | Password | No | Specify the password of the remote linux server, where the file is located. |
| Private Submission | Boolean | No | If enabled, action will submit the file privately. Note: this functionality requires premium VT access. |
| Fetch MITRE Details | Boolean | No | If enabled, action will return information about related MITRE techniques and tactics. |
| Lowest MITRE Technique Severity | Enum | No | Specify the lowest signature severity related to MITRE technique for technique to be returned. "Unknown" severity is treated as "Info". |
| Retrieve AI Summary | Boolean | No | Experimental. If enabled, action will retrieve an AI Summary for the submitted file. AI Summary is only available for private submissions. |
